I posted 41 reels last spring. Eleven of them did anything.

The weird part? The winners weren't the polished ones. My best reel — 212k views — was me filming my kitchen scale at 6am because I'd run out of oats and was annoyed about it. Took four minutes. No captions plan, no hook formula.

So I stopped storyboarding. Now I keep a note on my phone called "stuff that annoyed me today" and film from that. Views are up about 3x since March, though honestly I think half of that is just posting more.

Anyway. If you're stuck, go look at what bugged you this week. That's probably your next video.
